finding.title: Out-of-bounds read
finding.assumptions: The input vectors (node1Data, node2Data, link1, nextLink1) are populated with user-controlled data or data that is not properly validated.

parsed.change_summary: Added checks to ensure that `currentLink` is within bounds before accessing `node2Data[currentLink]`.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger `currentLink >= node2Data.size()` is blocked by adding checks at lines 26 and 39. If `currentLink` is out of bounds, the code now skips processing and moves to the next link or continues the loop, preventing out-of-bounds reads.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Searched for any bounds checks on currentLink before it is used to index node2Data. The only guard present is IsDefined(currentLink), which only tests for a sentinel value and does not verify that currentLink < node2Data.size(). No constant arguments or unreachable paths were found that would prevent the out‑of‑bounds read.
